2237.evidence: Item = BecsSeg 49853 (Kt. 48 Konv. 3 fol. 137-144, 147-151, 12 May 1583): 'Breuner sifrírozott jelentése és mellékletei, feloldás nélkül' (Breuner's ciphered report and its enclosures, no decipherment). Same day, same Konvolut: 49856, Breuner to Archduke Ernst, 'feloldás és sifrír' (decipherment and cipher), fol. 134-136, 158 and 147-151. The enclosures fol. 147-151 are listed under both regests; the 49856 summary names them (Marigliano's letter on Spanish plans; the English queen's letter), and its content summary covers the same news (a secret informer via Ragusa, two Spanish couriers on 8 May, the English ship, the beglerbeg of Rumelia sent to Sofia). The other 12 May 1583 regests (49857, 49858) are the pasha of Buda's letters with German translations, not Breuner. No other regest of that day in Türkei I (date search) and none dated as a range. In the same Konvolut Breuner's despatches of 24 Apr and 7 May are filed as a decipherment and a separate cipher copy for Rudolf (49842, 49848) and for Ernst (49844, 49849): the Rudolf and Ernst letters are separate letters of different lengths (fol. 59-70 vs 71-78; 95-105 vs 106-123), so 49856 is the parallel letter to Ernst, not a decipherment of the Rudolf despatch.
2237.leftover: The despatch to Rudolf itself, fol. 137-144 (eight folios), has no decipherment filed. The enclosures at fol. 147-151 belong to the deciphered Ernst letter as well and are probably clear or deciphered there (not stated). The Ernst decipherment (49856) is a same-day parallel text by the same writer: a strong crib, not the letter.
2237.recommendation: narrow: to the Rudolf despatch fol. 137-144 only (drop fol. 147-151, which are filed with the deciphered letter to Ernst, BecsSeg 49856); record 49856 and the deciphered 24 Apr / 7 May 1583 pairs (49842-49849) in key_in_volume as same-month key material and a parallel crib.

343.evidence: Item = BecsSeg 48359 (Kt. 37 Konv. 2 fol. 1-8, dated 1578.09.03-04., 09.06-07.): 'teljesen sifrírozott jelentés Sinzendorftól' (a report from Sinzendorff wholly in cipher). Same Konvolut, same dates: 48367 (fol. 29, 40-48), Sinzendorff to Rudolf, 'csak sifrír' (only cipher), 'durch Ofen', with exactly the same date string 03-04, 06-07 Sept; 48372 (fol. 62-75), Sinzendorff to Rudolf, 3-7 Sept 1578, 'feloldás külön' (decipherment separately), incipit 'Solle derselben ich bej gegenwürttig gelegenheit durch Ofen allergehorsamist weitters zuezueschreiben', a full content summary (Lozoviczky's mission from the Polish king, the Moldavian voivode and the Cossacks, Bekes, Persia). Konv. 3 holds the duplicate (48423, 'Duplicat vom 4. Septembris 1578', fol. 48-51) and the triplicate (48424, 'Triplicat der Expedition sampt Iren Einschlüssen ... in postscriptis vom 7. Septembris so zwaimal durch Ofen gangen ist', fol. 52-61). The enclosures A, B, F, Nr. 2, Nr. 3 (48360-48366, 48368) are in cipher, and F and Nr. 3 also with interlinear decipherment (48369, 48371). The separate letter of 4 Sept (48374, fol. 81-84) is 'sifrír és külön feloldás'. Inference: the despatch of 3-7 Sept went in at least three cipher copies (fol. 1-8, fol. 29/40-48, and the Konv. 3 duplicate and triplicate), and its decipherment is fol. 62-75. Leaves not seen; the identity of fol. 1-8 with the text deciphered at fol. 62-75 rests on the identical date string, the sender and recipient and the 'durch Ofen' route.
343.leftover: None of the despatch, if fol. 1-8 is a copy of the 3-7 Sept despatch as the dates say. Unconfirmed until a leaf is compared. Some enclosures (48360-48366, 48368) are cipher only, but the enclosures F and Nr. 3 have deciphered copies (48369, 48371).
343.recommendation: close (the decipherment is filed with it, Kt. 37 Konv. 2 fol. 62-75, BecsSeg 48372). It remains a key-recovery or known-plaintext test for targets/sinzendorff1578 if images are ever obtained.

342.evidence: Item = BecsSeg 47620 (Kt. 32 Konv. 3 fol. 199-203, 12 Mar 1576): 'Ungnad – Miksa (teljesen sifrírozott, minden feloldás nélküli jelentés)'. Konvolut listing (Kt. 32 Konv. 3, fol. 1-304): no other regest dated 12 Mar 1576 and no range-dated regest covering it; neighbours are Ungnad's 7 Mar despatch (47615-47617) and Vienna/Buda letters of 9-25 Mar. Date search '1576.03.12': no other Türkei I hit. Undated pieces in the Konvolut (47576 'Privilegium Transylvanicum' in cipher, not deciphered; 47603-47604 Italian translations) are not this letter.

501.evidence: Item = BecsSeg 43971 (Kt. 11 Konv. 5 fol. 73-74, 28 May 1555, Amasya): 'Verancsics Antal, Zay Ferenc és Augerius Busbecq – I. Ferdinánd (csupa sifrír)' (all cipher). Same Konvolut: 43973 (fol. 81-82), the same three envoys, 28 May 1555, Amasya, recipient '?', signed by Verancsics, no cipher named; 43974 (fol. 83-85), the same envoys to Ferdinand I, May 1555, Amasya, no cipher named; 43975 (fol. 86-95), the same envoys to Ferdinand I, May 1555, 'másolat' (a copy), with the note that more is written in Italian than in Latin for the sake of the Italian Turkish interpreter; 43972 (fol. 75-80) is their letter of 19 May. None is called a decipherment; whether 43973-43975 carry the clear text of the cipher sheet fol. 73-74 cannot be told from the regests. Date search '1555.05.28': no other hit.
501.leftover: The two-leaf cipher fol. 73-74, unless it is the ciphered part of the May letter 43974/43975.
501.recommendation: keep, with a note: the same envoys' clear letter and copy of May 1555 (BecsSeg 43973-43975, fol. 81-95) may hold its clear text; also check the printed Verancsics correspondence (Monumenta Hungariae Historica, Scriptores, Verancsics Antal összes munkái), not checked here.

2676.evidence: Item = BecsSeg 46735 (Kt. 28 Konv. 5 fol. 87-92, 93-96, 5 Sep 1572): 'Carolus Rym – Miksa (teljesen sifrír, csak a dátum feloldva, alul a duplikátum minősítés)' (wholly cipher, only the date deciphered, marked duplicate at the foot). Immediately before it in the same Konvolut: 46733 (fol. 79-84), 'Carolus Rym – Miksa (latin, sifrír, sorközben feloldva)', dated 4-5 Sep 1572, incipit 'Discesserunt hinc decimo quarto Augusti...' (Ungnad and Provisionali left on 14 Aug; the chiaus Achmat from Poland; Bogdan's brother Peter). Both are six folios (79-84 and 87-92), and 46735 is marked as the duplicate: it is the duplicate of the deciphered letter 46733 (inference from the same date, sender, recipient, equal length and the duplicate mark). 46734 (fol. 85-86, 5 Sep) is Rym's clear Latin letter to the abbot Joannes Cyrus, not this letter. Date search '1572.09.05': nothing else.
2676.leftover: Nothing, if fol. 87-92 is the duplicate of fol. 79-84 as the mark and the length say; fol. 93-96 (a further copy, or an enclosure) is not described separately.
2676.recommendation: close as an open cipher (decipherment of the same letter interlinear at fol. 79-84, BecsSeg 46733). The other Rym duplicate named in the entry, 46741 (28 Sep 1572, 'nincs feloldva'), is not part of the entry; not checked here.
